doc.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021

title: How Sun Ra wrote and changed scores
summary: Sun Ra wrote music like letters with keys and signatures but kept changing it; Allen says you must be in the spirit to remember.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Besides the Fletcher Henderson music, did he put key signatures in the music?
Yeah. He wrote music like he would write a letter.
He’d dot all the I’s and cross all your T’s.
I’m glad you put it that way.

Yeah so he’d put the signature and the key. That solved that. There’s nothing wrong with the music but if he gave it to you so fast you’ve got to jot down your way of remembering things. He makes a perfect piece of music. You still have so much other stuff in it that you have to jot down your little riffs and your little what time you come in you know. Because it’s hard to remember all that. And then get on the gig and don’t even play the song.
Did you ever have a trumpet player behind you go, “Hey Marshall, how’s my part go?”
Yeah. I did all of that. Where am I? Don’t forget.
Did he write a score first?

No I don’t do anything the normal way you see? Man I can give you your part now you see? That’s your part now to start but that is not the whole composition. So it’s not, it’s everything that I thought musicians were supposed to do and the way you do it, it’s all the opposite you see. And I used to have everything written out real nice and beautiful and oh, I got the sheet, and then he’d change all of that stuff. And then when I’d look at the music again you had to understand wait a minute, that’s been changed. You see? So it was like if you don’t put yourself in the spirit you can’t function. But when you do that man, all the other insignificant things are put aside, then you remember and it will come up at the right time, right place. You see?
Well you have a lot of faith.
That things are going to work out, and if they don’t then that creates something that works out in a different way I guess.
It’s just like the way you think today, what about tomorrow. You see? Tomorrow you’ve got some other thoughts. So it’s vibrations every day. Now today you do this and

tomorrow you read about what you done yesterday but you don’t do the same thing. You see natural — so there’s nothing except to capture that and use it and put it in the right place. And that’s like life is. You put the right things in the right place things go better for you or the like.
